nina_support: escalation incoming — Spectrum Health (tenant:spectrum-hlth) onboarding blocked. Bulk embeddings job returns 403; SSO hangs at SAML step. Customer needs greenlight for pilot in 48h. Ticket#83421. :rotating_light:
watchdog_bot: Ticket #83421 created by nina_support. Severity: high.
nina_support: repro snippet: curl POST /v1/embeddings -> {\"error\":403, \"code\":\"quota_block\"}. last_success: 1833330000. debug token tx_Sp3.
omar_cs: I'll own comms. Draft ack: "Thanks — we're triaging and will call in 30m. Temporary fallback to resume ingest without full re-upload is being prepared." Approve?
nina_support: approved by customer, 14:30 PST ok.
lia_ops: quick triage shows routing flag flip sent some tenants to the shared quota pool between 1833329980-1833330050. I can enable tenant prefix cache + route to m-lite as fallback. CLI: redwood-cli tenant update spectrum-hlth --prefix-cache on --route m-lite. Will wait for ack to apply.
omar_cs: send ack now and schedule 14:30 PST invite. Lia, apply fallback after I confirm.
watchdog_bot: Acknowledgement sent to customer by omar_cs at 1833330030.
lia_ops: applied fallback at 1833330060. Metrics: 403s dropped to 0; ingest throughput returned to normal. :rocket:
omar_cs: running enablement call at 14:30 PST. Quick handoff note: issue type = onboarding routing->shared-quota; mitigation = temporary route to m-lite + prefix cache; owners = lia_ops (ops), nina_support (support), omar_cs (CS). Renewal risk = medium, monitor 48h then remove flag if stable.
nina_support: attaching SAML trace & logs to ticket. Will follow up if any regression. :white_check_mark:
